title: limonium ochranthum
intro: Limonium ochranthum, commonly known as Sea Lavender or Statice, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Plumbaginaceae family. It is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of arthritis and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Limonium ochranthum include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve skin health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine and phytomedicine.
